hints.title: Total Sum Divisibility
hints.text: Let total_sum be the sum of all node values. Any valid component sum target must be a divisor of total_sum and at least max(nums).

hints.title: Subtree Sum Check
hints.text: For a candidate target, traverse the tree with a depth-first traversal. Each node sums its own value and returned child sums.

hints.title: Edge Cutting Condition
hints.text: If a subtree sum equals target, cut the incoming edge to that subtree and return 0 upward. If a subtree sum exceeds target, this target is impossible.

hints.title: Tree Partition Divisor Validation Implementation

complexity.notes: Testing each valid divisor requires a linear depth-first traversal.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Evaluating all 2^(n-1) edge removal combinations causes exponential explosion.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Adjacency list and call stack require linear O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that equal component sums must divide total sum and verifies via bottom-up subtree pruning.
